deviations.description: Cord goal below the anatomical floor by less than about 3 Gy: the network plans instead of escalating. It applies rule C only when cord_floor exceeds cord_lim by roughly 3 Gy or more, instead of by any amount. If rule A, B or D applies, the request is still escalated correctly.
deviations.condition: (cord_floor - cord_lim > 0.3) and (cord_floor - cord_lim < 3.0) and not (cov > cap) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim)) and (missing == 0)
